headline: Midwestern State finish top of the table unbeaten
dek: Midwestern State closed their conference season by beating St. Mary's on Wednesday, and finish it ahead of Oklahoma Christian, the only other side without a conference defeat. In all their matches they have won fourteen and drawn four without a loss, conceding thirteen goals.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Thirteen different players have scored Midwestern State's 49 goals, and Parker Plaxco has fifteen of them.

wire.line: Midwestern State and Oklahoma Christian have yet to lose a conference match, and they drew with each other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian have lost three times, and none of the three came in conference play.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have lost twice, against eleven wins and six draws, and conceded fifteen goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all sixteen of their matches and scored twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 78 saves for Sul Ross State.

last_match.line: The two had drawn at Dallas Baptist in conference play; St. Mary's took the second meeting, and go to Oklahoma Christian next.

next_match.line: UT Dallas have not lost since Midwestern State beat them in conference play; Midwestern State have not lost at all.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
